definitions.explanation: A formal expression of regret for wrongdoing, often public or official.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{公式|こうしき}に{謝罪|しゃざい}した。
examples.english: The company issued an official apology.

examples.japanese: {謝罪|しゃざい}{会見|かいけん}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: They held an apology press conference.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}からの{謝罪|しゃざい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。

notes:
VERB FORM:
{謝罪|しゃざい}する (to apologize formally)

USAGE:
Used for formal or serious apologies, especially:
・{公式|こうしき}{謝罪|しゃざい} (official apology)
・{謝罪|しゃざい}{会見|かいけん} (apology press conference)
・{謝罪|しゃざい}{文|ぶん} (written apology)
・{謝罪|しゃざい}を{求|もと}める (to demand an apology)
・{謝罪|しゃざい}を{受|う}け{入|い}れる (to accept an apology)

CULTURE:
In Japan, formal apologies often involve bowing deeply. Public figures and companies often hold press conferences to apologize for scandals or problems.

REGISTER:
Formal. For casual apologies, use {謝|あやま}る or ごめん(なさい).

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{謝|あやま}る - to apologize (general)
・{詫|わ}びる - to apologize (humble)
・{陳謝|ちんしゃ} - formal apology (even more formal)
